concerns.text: The primary threshold (SC‑001) relies on the additivity assumption that quantization‑induced error equals the difference between total error (quantized MSE) and instrumental‑only error (float64 MSE). While FR‑015 proposes a separate sensitivity analysis to validate this assumption, the main crossover detection uses the difference directly. If the additivity assumption fails (e.g., interaction between quantization noise and stochastic instrumental noise), the identified SNR crossover may be biased. Recommend either (a) integrating the direct quantization‑noise measurement into the primary threshold calculation, or (b) explicitly stating that the crossover is conditional on the additivity validation passing, and aborting the analysis if the deviation exceeds the 5 % tolerance.)
